_note: Hand-written SYNTHETIC examples in the same shape as the indexed doctor-patient cases (id, patient text, doctor reply). The real index (data/chroma_dialogues) is built from public Hugging Face datasets by src/backend/scripts/build_dialogue_index.py; its rows are not redistributed here.

cases.patient: I have had a sore throat and mild fever for two days. It hurts to swallow.
cases.doctor: This looks like a viral throat infection. Rest, warm fluids and paracetamol for the fever. See a doctor if it lasts more than 5 days or you cannot swallow.

cases.patient: My child has a cough at night and a blocked nose, no fever.
cases.doctor: Common cold is likely. Saline drops, steam and fluids help. Seek review if breathing becomes fast or the cough lasts beyond 2 weeks.

cases.patient: Stomach pain on the right lower side that is getting worse, with nausea.
cases.doctor: Pain that moves to the right lower abdomen with nausea can be appendicitis. Please go to an emergency department today.
